description:
# 1.47.0-mod.6

* Fix Duolingo Firebase Installations registration after Manager signing by preserving the original package and certificate identity in FIS requests.
* Continue using MicroG RE for FCM registration; other apps keep their existing MicroG behavior.
* Preserve the Restore learning reminders startup fix and automatic upstream synchronization.
* Validated on Duolingo 6.102.4 with Manager 2.0.0 (SUPER and MAX).
